text_en: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her vindication shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning torch.
text_cn: 为了熙雍我决不缄默，为了耶路撒冷我决不休息，直到她的正义显现有如光明，她的救恩燃灼有如火炬。

text_en: The nations shall see your vindication, and all the kings your glory; and you shall be called by a new name that the mouth of the Lord will give.
text_cn: 万民都要见到你的正义，众王都要看见你的荣耀；人要给你起一个新的名号，是上主亲口所指定的。

text_en: You shall be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord , and a royal diadem in the hand of your God.
text_cn: 你将是上主手中的荣冠，是你天主掌上的王冕。

text_en: You shall no more be termed Forsaken, and your land shall no more be termed Desolate; but you shall be called My Delight Is in Her, and your land Married; for the Lord delights in you, and your land shall be married.
text_cn: 你不再称为“被遗弃的，”你的地域也不再称为“荒凉的；”因为你要称为“我可爱的”，你的地域要称为“已婚的”，因为上主喜爱你，你的地域将要婚嫁。

text_en: For as a young man marries a young woman, so shall your builder marry you, and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you.
text_cn: 就如青年怎样娶处女，你的建造者也要怎样娶你；新郎怎样喜爱新娘，你的天主也要怎样喜爱你。

text_en: Upon your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted sentinels; all day and all night they shall never be silent. You who remind the Lord , take no rest,
text_cn: 耶路撒冷啊！ 我在你的城墙上派了守望者，他们日夜总不缄默；提醒上主的人哪！你们总不要休息！

text_en: and give him no rest until he establishes Jerusalem and makes it renowned throughout the earth.
text_cn: 你们也不要让他休息，直到他建立了熙雍，直到他使耶路撒冷在大地成为可赞美的。

text_en: The Lord has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: I will not again give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners shall not drink the wine for which you have labored;
text_cn: 上主凭他的右手和他强有力的手臂发誓说：“我决不再将你的五谷交给你的仇人吃，也决不再让外邦人喝你所劳作的美酒。

text_en: but those who garner it shall eat it and praise the Lord , and those who gather it shall drink it in my holy courts.
text_cn: 惟有那收割的能吃，并颂扬上主；那收集的，将在我圣殿的庭院里喝。”

text_en: Go through, go through the gates, prepare the way for the people; build up, build up the highway, clear it of stones, lift up an ensign over the peoples.
text_cn: 过去！经过大门吧！ 修平人民的路！ 修路！ 把路修好，除去上面的石头；你们要为万民竖起一面旗帜。

text_en: The Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth: Say to daughter Zion, “See, your salvation comes; his reward is with him, and his recompense before him. ”
text_cn: 看哪！上主向大地四极宣布说：你们应向熙雍女子说：看！ 你的救主来了！ 看！ 他的胜利品与他同在，他获得的酬劳在他面前。

text_en: They shall be called, “The Holy People, The Redeemed of the Lord ”; and you shall be called, “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken. ”
text_cn: 人要称他们为“圣洁的民族”，“上主赎回的”。你要被称为“蒙爱的”，“不被弃的城”。
